statement: Provide adequate lighting in every area.

statement: Provide adequate ventilation.

statement: Where appropriate for making, processing, packing or holding a drug product, provide equipment that adequately controls air pressure, micro-organisms, dust, humidity and temperature.

statement: Keep air-handling systems for manufacturing, processing and packing penicillin completely separate from those serving other human drug products.

statement: Supply potable water under continuous positive pressure through plumbing that has no defects that could contaminate any drug product.
quote: Potable water shall be supplied under continuous positive pressure in a plumbing system free of defects that could contribute contamination to any drug product.

statement: Ensure potable water meets the EPA Primary Drinking Water Regulations in 40 CFR part 141, and do not allow water that fails those standards into the potable water system.
quote: Potable water shall meet the standards prescribed in the Environmental Protection Agency's Primary Drinking Water Regulations set forth in 40 CFR part 141. Water not meeting such standards shall not be permitted in the potable water system.

statement: Make drains of adequate size.
quote: Drains shall be of adequate size

statement: Where a drain connects directly to a sewer, fit it with an air break or other mechanical device that prevents back-siphonage.

statement: Dispose of sewage, trash and other refuse from the building and its immediate surroundings safely and hygienically.
quote: Sewage, trash, and other refuse in and from the building and immediate premises shall be disposed of in a safe and sanitary manner.

statement: Provide adequate hand-washing facilities with hot and cold water, soap or detergent, air dryers or single-use towels, and clean toilets that are easy to reach from working areas.
quote: Adequate washing facilities shall be provided, including hot and cold water, soap or detergent, air driers or single-service towels, and clean toilet facilities easily accesible to working areas.

statement: Keep every building used to manufacture, process, pack or hold drug products clean and sanitary.
quote: Any building used in the manufacture, processing, packing, or holding of a drug product shall be maintained in a clean and sanitary condition

statement: Keep every building used to manufacture, process, pack or hold drug products free of rodents, birds, insects and other vermin, other than laboratory animals.
quote: Any such building shall be free of infestation by rodents, birds, insects, and other vermin (other than laboratory animals).

statement: Hold and dispose of trash and organic waste promptly and hygienically.
quote: Trash and organic waste matter shall be held and disposed of in a timely and sanitary manner.

statement: Have written sanitation procedures that assign responsibility for sanitation and describe in enough detail the cleaning schedules, methods, equipment and materials used to clean buildings and facilities.
quote: There shall be written procedures assigning responsibility for sanitation and describing in sufficient detail the cleaning schedules, methods, equipment, and materials to be used in cleaning the buildings and facilities

statement: Follow the written sanitation and building cleaning procedures.

statement: Keep every building used to manufacture, process, pack or hold drug products in good repair.
quote: Any building used in the manufacture, processing, packing, or holding of a drug product shall be maintained in a good state of repair.

quote: Equipment used in the manufacture, processing, packing, or holding of a drug product shall be of appropriate design, adequate size, and suitably located to facilitate operations for its intended use and for its cleaning and maintenance.

statement: Clean and maintain equipment and utensils, and sanitize and/or sterilize them as appropriate for the nature of the drug, at appropriate intervals to prevent malfunctions or contamination that would alter the drug product's safety, identity, strength, quality or purity beyond official or other established requirements.
quote: Equipment and utensils shall be cleaned, maintained, and, as appropriate for the nature of the drug, sanitized and/or sterilized at appropriate intervals to prevent malfunctions or contamination that would alter the safety, identity, strength, quality, or purity of the drug product beyond the official or other established requirements.

statement: Handle and store components and drug product containers and closures at all times so as to prevent contamination.
